subject: english
question: What do great leaders have in common?

options.text: They follow a fixed daily routine.
They are not tied by limits of time.
They plan and use their time wisely.

solution:
Th correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the given passage*** "All the great leaders have one thing in common. They wisely utilize every moment of their time. When other people are busy in wasting time in laziness, great men are busy in making plans for the future."***
 
• In the context of the passage the best option which fits is the '**option 4'.**

Hence the correct option is '***OPTION 4'*** which is*** 'They plan and use their time wisely.'***
